name: ReSharper
help: The ReSharper command line tools run ReSharper's code inspections and code cleanup outside the IDE. They ship as the <c>jb</c> global .NET tool (package <c>JetBrains.ReSharper.GlobalTools</c>).<para/>The tool path is resolved in this order: the <c>RESHARPER_EXE</c> environment variable, a <c>jb</c> executable on the PATH (for example, after <c>dotnet tool install --global JetBrains.ReSharper.GlobalTools</c>), and then the <c>JetBrains.ReSharper.GlobalTools</c> package in the NuGet packages folder (add it as a <c>PackageDownload</c> item to the build project).

tasks.help: InspectCode runs ReSharper's code inspections on a solution or project and writes the issues it finds to a report. The default report format is SARIF.

properties.name: TargetPath
properties.help: The solution or project file to inspect.

properties.name: Output
properties.help: The report file. Use <c>-</c> to write the report to stdout.

properties.name: Format
properties.help: The report format. The default is <c>Sarif</c>.

properties.name: Jobs
properties.help: Run up to this many jobs in parallel. <c>0</c> means as many as possible, which is the default.

properties.name: AbsolutePaths
properties.help: Write absolute paths to the report. By default, paths are relative to the solution file.

properties.name: Project
properties.help: Inspect only the projects that match this wildcard, for example <c>--project=*Billing</c>. By default, all projects in the solution are inspected.

properties.name: TargetFramework
properties.help: Inspect for one target framework only, for example <c>net10.0</c>. By default, all frameworks are inspected.

properties.name: Severity
properties.help: The lowest severity to report. The default is <c>SUGGESTION</c>.

properties.name: DumpIssuesTypes
properties.help: Write all known code inspections to the report instead of inspecting code. Use it without a target path.

tasks.help: CleanupCode runs a code cleanup profile on a solution or project, so that formatting and code style issues are fixed across the code base.

properties.name: TargetPath
properties.help: The solution or project file to clean up.

properties.name: Profile
properties.help: The name of the code cleanup profile to run. By default, the Built-in: Full Cleanup profile is used.

resharper.name: Settings
resharper.help: A .DotSettings file whose settings override all other settings layers. By default, the team-shared layer of the solution is used if it exists.

resharper.name: NoBuiltinSettings
resharper.help: Turn off all global, solution and project settings layers. Same as <c>--disable-settings-layers=GlobalAll;GlobalPerProduct;SolutionShared;SolutionPersonal;ProjectShared;ProjectPersonal</c>.

resharper.name: Extensions
resharper.help: ReSharper extensions to install and use. Available extensions are listed in the plugin repository.

resharper.name: Sources
resharper.help: The sources to install extensions from.

auxiliary.name: CreateConfigFile
auxiliary.help: Save the current parameters to this configuration file.

auxiliary.name: ConfigFile
auxiliary.help: Load the parameters from this configuration file.

auxiliary.name: Verbosity
auxiliary.help: How much information to write to the console. The default is <c>INFO</c>.

msbuild.name: Properties
msbuild.help: MSBuild properties that apply to all analyzed projects.

msbuild.name: Toolset
msbuild.help: The MSBuild toolset version, for example <c>17.0</c>. By default, the highest available version is used.

msbuild.name: ToolsetPath
msbuild.help: The path to the MSBuild executable or DLL.

msbuild.name: DotNetCore
msbuild.help: The path to the <c>dotnet</c> executable. By default, it is detected automatically.

msbuild.name: DotNetCoreSdk
msbuild.help: The .NET SDK version that provides MSBuild, for example <c>10.0.100</c>.

msbuild.name: MonoPath
msbuild.help: The path to Mono. Leave it empty to ignore Mono.

msbuild.name: ReferenceTargets
msbuild.help: MSBuild targets that are run to get the referenced assemblies of projects.

msbuild.name: ItemTargets
msbuild.help: MSBuild targets that are run to get other items of projects, for example <c>Compile</c> items.

msbuild.name: Build
msbuild.help: Build the solution before processing. This is the default.

msbuild.name: NoBuild
msbuild.help: Don't build the solution before processing. Use it when the solution is already built.

msbuild.name: Target
msbuild.help: The MSBuild target to run before processing. The default is <c>Build</c>.

include-exclude.name: Includes
include-exclude.help: Process only the files that match these relative paths or wildcards (<c>*</c> and <c>**</c>).

include-exclude.name: Excludes
include-exclude.help: Skip the files that match these relative paths or wildcards (<c>*</c> and <c>**</c>). <c>--exclude</c> wins over <c>--include</c>.
